'''Phantom Squadron''' was elite squadron formed by the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]]. The Phantom's were created in the spirit of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] fighter unit [[Wraith Squadron]]. Like the Wraith's of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Phantom Squadron pilots were selected for their dual skills as pilots and commandos. In addition, the pilots selected for the squadron often were a mix of highly skilled yet volatile characters. Despite the rough and ready nature of the squadron and its unorthodox tactics, Phantoms were loyal to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]] and the GA Remnant.
